_comment: The second full-dataset cell, resized to the day's remaining budget after
the budget run in full.json turned out to cost 21-26 minutes per epoch and
to use all eight of them. Four epochs: the third is the like-for-like
against v1's three, and the per-epoch curve keeps it, while the fourth is
one more than v1 ever got.
This is the run docs/results.md reports as lr1e-2-t0.05-4ep: warm
recall@500 0.0591, the best two-tower number measured on this project, and
still 3.9x below the popularity fallback's 0.2310 on the same users.
